CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- The service boundary manages history behind runtime context handles.
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService privately maps handles to CanvasHistory.
|   |-- openContext creates history and freezes a new handle.
|   |   `-- WeakMap keys isolate viewers and permit collection when handles disappear.
|   |-- state exposes the checkpoint, document, view and undo or redo availability.
|   |-- resolve asks history's diagram editor for the context's diagram view.
|   `-- Handles and the service are excluded from saved canvases.
|-- Public operations delegate history work through this boundary.
|   |-- append receives the document, view and optional node correspondence.
|   |-- navigate rejects a linked transfer and otherwise delegates undo or redo.
|   |-- reset, forkContext and adopt delegate reset, fork and adoption.
|   `-- Export, persistence deltas and transaction retirement serve adapters.
|       `-- Callers must not interpret diagram revision tables.
|-- Transfer helpers require participant history and transaction information.
|   |-- prepareTransfer exports the source and optional destination histories.
|   |-- transferBoundary compares a history head through the imported helper.
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation exports both participants for coordinated navigation.
|-- MappingWorkspacePage coordinates transfer publication.
|   |-- Transfer preparation checks busy state and the captured source checkpoint.
|   |-- runWorkspaceTask receives histories, selection, mode and proposed views.
|   |   `-- The proposal updates participant documents and the workspace transaction list.
|   |-- publishTransfer awaits WorkspaceStorage.save before installing sessions.
|   `-- Workspace undo or redo requires both participating controllers.
|       |-- Newer applied transfers involving either participant block undo.
|       `-- An undone newly created destination is hidden; redo reveals it.
|-- WorkspacePersistence translates live state into storage records.
|   |-- It manages per-session delta cursors, known drafts and subscriptions.
|   |-- sync requests controller persistenceChanges using the session cursor.
|   |-- It combines history changes with metadata, baselines and canvas state.
|   |   `-- Display and camera captures require SourcePaneViewState.
|   |-- Replaced histories remove obsolete revision and checkpoint records.
|   |-- The workspace index retains document IDs, active ID and transfers.
|   `-- Pausing suppresses synchronization; disposal releases subscriptions.
|-- RecordStorage manages local records and pending writes.
|   |-- batch updates its cache and coalesces changes by record key.
|   |-- A single in-flight batch retains a request ID and expected revision.
|   |   `-- The transport acknowledgement advances the persisted sequence.
|   |-- flush waits for writes through its captured sequence.
|   |-- commit restores the previous cache on definitive rejection.
|   |   `-- Ambiguous failures retry the same request before another write.
|   `-- Disposal closes storage and clears timers and listeners.
`-- WorkspaceStorage manages the worker and RecordStorage lifetime.
    |-- load creates RecordStorage after the worker supplies initial records.
    |-- Worker requests are correlated with private pending promises.
    |   `-- Failure rejects outstanding requests and terminates the worker.
    |-- save flushes earlier writes, projects the snapshot and commits changes.
    |-- restore flushes and disposes old records before reloading.
    `-- Disposal terminates the worker and rejects outstanding requests.
